[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Makuskett''' was the [[Chair of Metagrowth and Polymorphism]] at the [[University of Sanbra]]. He had an anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bias. He thrice traveled to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and twice sojourned amongst the [[Gupin/Legends|Gupins]], having close encounters with dangerous [[Grass Trekker/Legends|Grass Trekkers]]; in one of his trips, in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], he was part of a group of biologists sent to study the indigenous and introduced lifeforms of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and took a [[Concussion rifle/Legends|concussion rifle]] to fend off the Grass Trekkers. He was particularly interested in Gupin shapeshifting and in the local [[Magic/Legends|magic]].<ref name="Standoff on Leritor" />
